changelog.en: Closes two more security false-negatives: the pipe-to-shell env wrapper (curl … | env bash and | /usr/bin/env bash — the canonical portable interpreter shape, which the v0.6.0 fix named but never actually matched) now trips SK-SHELL-002 HIGH; and the comment stripper is now backslash-aware inside double quotes so an escaped \" no longer closes the string and hides a trailing curl exfil behind a quoted #.
changelog.zh: 再修两处安全漏报：pipe-to-shell 的 env 包装（curl … | env bash 与 | /usr/bin/env bash —— 便携式解释器调用的标准形态，v0.6.0 点名却没真正匹配上）现在触发 SK-SHELL-002 HIGH；注释剥离器在双引号内改为反斜杠感知，转义的 \" 不再提前闭合字符串、把紧跟在带引号 # 之后的 curl 外联藏起来。

changelog.en: Closes three security false-negatives: pipe-to-shell absolute-path evasion (/bin/sh, /usr/bin/bash, /bin/zsh now trip SK-SHELL-002 HIGH), a quote-blind comment stripper that hid a trailing curl exfil behind a quoted #, and missing HTTP methods (requests.put/delete/patch/head/options, and fetch with a space) in the HTTP-client regex.
changelog.zh: 修复三处安全漏报：pipe-to-shell 绝对路径绕过（/bin/sh、/usr/bin/bash、/bin/zsh 现在触发 SK-SHELL-002 HIGH）、引号不敏感的注释剥离器把紧跟在带引号 # 之后的 curl 外联藏起来、以及 HTTP 客户端正则漏匹配 requests.put/delete/patch/head/options 与带空格的 fetch。

eyebrow.zh: 装前体检 · 与 star 数无关

headline.zh:
装一个 skill 之前
先看清它会对你的机器做什么
headline.en:
Before you install a skill
see what it'll do to your machine

sub.zh: trending 上的 agentic skill 包，在你点安装的那一刻就能跑 shell、挂 hook、往外联网。star 数可以刷，它不告诉你这些。skvet 在装之前把包扫一遍，给一个与 star 无关的 LOW/MED/HIGH 判定——装不装，你自己拿主意。
sub.en: A trending agentic skill bundle can run shell, register hooks, and call out the moment you install it. Star count is gameable and tells you none of that. skvet scans the bundle before install and gives a stars-orthogonal LOW/MED/HIGH verdict — you make the call.

scroll.en: See what it catches for you

title.zh: 与 star 数无关的风险分
title.en: A risk score that ignores stars

body.zh: star 数可以刷、可以买，41k star 的库照样能在安装那一刻 curl|sh。skvet 的判定全程不读 star 数，只看包里到底会对你的机器做什么，报告底部还提醒一句 stars ≠ safe。
body.en: Stars are gameable and buyable — a 41k-star repo can still curl|sh on install. skvet's verdict never reads star count; it looks only at what the bundle will do to your machine, and the report carries a stars ≠ safe reminder.

title.zh: 装前就告诉你它会对机器做什么
title.en: Tells you what it'll do to your machine — before install

body.zh: 随包附带的 shell 脚本、curl|sh 式远程执行、挂在生命周期事件上自动触发的 hook、对外网的调用——装之前就逐条列出来，每条都带文件、行号、代码片段，你能一条条自己质疑，而不是面对一个黑盒分数。
body.en: Shipped shell scripts, curl|sh remote execution, auto-firing hooks on lifecycle events, outbound calls — listed one by one before you install, each with file, line, and snippet so you can challenge any rule instead of facing a black-box score.

chips: › 自动触发的生命周期 hook

title.zh: 在 CI 里直接拦下高风险安装
title.en: Block risky installs right in CI

body.zh: 整体风险达到你设的阈值，skvet 直接以非零退出码退出，塞进 CI 当装前闸门，不用自己解析输出。阈值可调——MEDIUM 及以上就拦，还是只拦 HIGH，你定。
body.en: When overall risk hits your threshold, skvet exits non-zero and drops into CI as a pre-install gate — no output parsing. Tune the threshold yourself: block at MEDIUM, or only at HIGH.

title.zh: 一个工具，管所有宿主的 skill 包
title.en: One tool for every host's skill bundles

body.zh: Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、Antigravity——每家宿主各自的签名注册表盖不住 trending 上冒出来的包。skvet 看的是 skill 包本身长什么样，所以这些宿主全管。本地跑，不上传你的代码，也不用注册账号。
body.en: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity — each host's signed registry can't cover what surfaces on trending. skvet looks at the bundle's shape, so it covers all of them. Runs locally, never uploads your code, needs no account.

headline.zh: 装前一步，把决定权拿回来
headline.en: Take the call back, before you install

sub.zh: 免费、开源。skvet 只做报告，装不装的判断在你。
sub.en: Free, open-source. skvet reports — you decide.

tag.zh: Apache-2.0 开源 · 与 star 数无关的装前风险分
tag.en: Apache-2.0 open-source · a stars-orthogonal pre-install risk score
